function.name: compute_tax
function.description: Calculates the tax based on the taxable income and filing status of an individual. It also considers the state of residence to apply state-specific tax rules. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

taxable_income.description: The individual's income subject to tax, before any deductions or exemptions, in USD. This is a float type value.

filing_status.description: The taxpayer's filing status which determines the rate at which income is taxed.

state_of_residence.description: The U.S. state where the taxpayer is a resident, which affects the calculation of state taxes.

deductions.description: The total amount of deductions the individual is claiming, which will reduce the taxable income, in USD. This is a float type value.

exemptions.description: The number of exemptions claimed by the taxpayer, reducing the taxable income further.

tax_year.description: The tax year for which the tax calculation is being performed. It defaults to the current year if not specified.

Shashi Tej Reddy (born 1975) is an Indian entrepreneur and philanthropist best known for founding **ReddyTech Solutions**, a Bangalore‑based software development firm that specializes in AI‑driven analytics for the healthcare sector. He graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Science from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay in 1997 and later earned an MBA from Stanford Graduate School of Business in 2002.

After a stint as a senior engineer at Infosys, Reddy launched ReddyTech in 2008. Under his leadership, the company grew from a handful of developers to a global team of over 300 employees, securing major contracts with several Fortune 500 pharmaceutical companies. In 2015 he was named one of Forbes India’s “30 under 30” for technology entrepreneurship.

Beyond business, Reddy is active in social causes. He founded the **Reddy Foundation** in 2012, which focuses on improving digital literacy in rural Karnataka through free coding bootcamps and scholarships. He has also served on the advisory board of the World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council on Digital Health.

Reddy currently resides in Bengaluru with his wife, Dr. Ananya Reddy, and their two children. He continues to steer ReddyTech’s expansion into emerging markets while championing sustainable tech practices.
